## Your recommendation

### Put it in writing

In a few sentences, write the recommendation you would give to the people
who own this test: Which model you would use, the evidence for it, and one
limitation or item that needs a closer look.

```{r {{id}}-q-write}
question_text(
  "Your recommendation:",
  answer_fn(function(value) {
    if (nchar(trimws(value)) < 80)
      return(incorrect("Write a bit more: name the model, the evidence and at least one limitation."))
    correct("Thanks. Your instructor may ask you to submit this text.")
  }),
  correct = "Submitted.", allow_retry = TRUE, rows = 6)
```
